scope: Overtaking (passing another vehicle, and being passed) in Ontario, including passing stopped vehicles and shared-road situations where the handbook gives passing-specific instructions.

vocabulary.definition: The person operating the vehicle to which the rule applies.
A manoeuvre to overtake and move past another vehicle, ordinarily by changing lanes.
An area to the side of a vehicle that its driver cannot see directly ahead or in the mirrors.
A designated pedestrian crossing without regular traffic lights, identified by specific signs and pavement markings and sometimes equipped with flashing overhead yellow lights.
A physical barrier, such as a raised, lowered, earth or paved strip, that separates traffic travelling in opposite directions and cannot be crossed by vehicles.
A high-speed multilane road with separated directions of travel and ramps for entry and exit.
A pavement marking consisting of two chevrons above a bicycle symbol that indicates a lane shared by vehicles and bicycles.
An orange triangle with a red border displayed on a vehicle to warn that it travels at 40 km/h or less.
A double-trailer commercial vehicle that can be up to 40 metres long and is identified by a rear placard.

rules.title: Keep right except to pass or turn left
rules.when: driving along a road
rules.action: keep to the right of the road or in the right-hand lane on a multilane road
rules.unless: preparing to turn left OR preparing to PASS another vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN driving along a road, the DRIVER MUST keep to the right of the road or in the right-hand lane on a multilane road, UNLESS preparing to turn left OR preparing to PASS another vehicle.
rules.note: The handbook emphasizes this instruction for drivers travelling more slowly than other traffic.

rules.title: Pass only when safe
rules.when: considering a PASS
rules.action: begin the PASS
rules.unless: sure there is enough space and time to complete it without danger to anyone
rules.statement: WHEN considering a PASS, the DRIVER MUST NOT begin the PASS, UNLESS sure there is enough space and time to complete it without danger to anyone.

vague_terms.explanation: no minimum gap or time given
requires assessing the risks of the manoeuvre

rules.title: Signal and check before pulling out
rules.when: preparing to pull out to PASS
rules.action: check the mirrors and the BLIND SPOT in the direction of the lane change, signal in that direction, and verify that the way is clear ahead and behind before moving
rules.statement: WHEN preparing to pull out to PASS, the DRIVER MUST check the mirrors and the BLIND SPOT in the direction of the lane change, signal in that direction, and verify that the way is clear ahead and behind before moving.

vague_terms.explanation: no minimum gap or sight distance given

rules.note: The passing procedure illustrates a pass on the left and specifies the left-turn signal; the lane-change instructions specify the signal for whichever direction is used.

rules.title: Watch for hidden and entering road users
rules.when: preparing to PASS another vehicle
rules.action: watch for bicycles and small vehicles hidden ahead of that vehicle, vehicles turning left ahead, and vehicles or pedestrians entering from another road or driveway
rules.statement: WHEN preparing to PASS another vehicle, the DRIVER MUST watch for bicycles and small vehicles hidden ahead of that vehicle, vehicles turning left ahead, and vehicles or pedestrians entering from another road or driveway.

rules.title: Signal and leave room before returning
rules.when: returning to the original lane after overtaking another vehicle
rules.action: signal before moving and wait until the entire front of the overtaken vehicle is visible in the inside rearview mirror before changing lanes without cutting it off
rules.statement: WHEN returning to the original lane after overtaking another vehicle, the DRIVER MUST signal before moving and wait until the entire front of the overtaken vehicle is visible in the inside rearview mirror before changing lanes without cutting it off.

vague_terms.explanation: no additional return gap specified

rules.note: The same mirror check and signal are specified for night passing; the diagram shows a gradual return.

rules.title: Abandon a pass if the other vehicle speeds up
rules.when: the vehicle being overtaken speeds up during a PASS
rules.action: return to the original lane instead of racing the other vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle being overtaken speeds up during a PASS, the DRIVER MUST return to the original lane instead of racing the other vehicle.

rules.title: Use low beams on approach at night
rules.when: approaching another vehicle from behind at night to PASS
rules.action: switch the headlights to low beams
rules.statement: WHEN approaching another vehicle from behind at night to PASS, the DRIVER MUST switch the headlights to low beams.

vague_terms.explanation: the passing procedure gives no switch point

rules.note: This is the approach step; the separate general rule requires low beams when following at less than 60 metres, with a passing exception.

rules.title: Switch to high beams alongside at night
rules.when: passing at night AND moving alongside the vehicle being overtaken
rules.action: switch on the high beams
rules.unless: an oncoming vehicle is within 150 metres
rules.statement: WHEN passing at night AND moving alongside the vehicle being overtaken, the DRIVER MUST switch on the high beams, UNLESS an oncoming vehicle is within 150 metres.
rules.note: The exception preserves the general oncoming low-beam rule, which also applies on divided roads.

rules.title: Do not pass a vehicle stopped at a crosswalk
rules.when: another vehicle is stopped at a marked or unmarked crosswalk
rules.action: PASS the stopped vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN another vehicle is stopped at a marked or unmarked crosswalk, the DRIVER MUST NOT PASS the stopped vehicle.
rules.note: The stopped vehicle may conceal a pedestrian who is crossing.

rules.title: No passing within 30 metres of a pedestrian crossover
rules.when: within 30 metres of a PEDESTRIAN CROSSOVER
rules.action: PASS any vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN within 30 metres of a PEDESTRIAN CROSSOVER, the DRIVER MUST NOT PASS any vehicle.

rules.title: No passing left of centre near specified structures
rules.when: within 30 metres of a bridge, viaduct or tunnel
rules.action: PASS to the left of the centreline
rules.statement: WHEN within 30 metres of a bridge, viaduct or tunnel, the DRIVER MUST NOT PASS to the left of the centreline.

rules.title: Do not pass with insufficient sight distance at a crest or curve
rules.when: approaching a hill crest or travelling on a curve with an obstructed view of oncoming traffic AND there is not enough clear distance ahead to pass in safety
rules.action: attempt to PASS
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a hill crest or travelling on a curve with an obstructed view of oncoming traffic AND there is not enough clear distance ahead to pass in safety, the DRIVER MUST NOT attempt to PASS.

vague_terms.term: not enough clear distance ahead to pass in safety
vague_terms.explanation: no minimum sight distance specified

rules.title: Obey a no-passing sign
rules.when: on a road governed by a no-passing regulatory sign
rules.action: PASS another vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN on a road governed by a no-passing regulatory sign, the DRIVER MUST NOT PASS another vehicle.
rules.note: The sign shows two vehicles in a red prohibition circle.

rules.title: No passing from the crossover sign to the crossing
rules.when: between a sign reading “No Passing Here to Crossing” and the PEDESTRIAN CROSSOVER it marks
rules.action: PASS another vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN between a sign reading “No Passing Here to Crossing” and the PEDESTRIAN CROSSOVER it marks, the DRIVER MUST NOT PASS another vehicle.
rules.note: The signed extent of the prohibition is shown in the figure, not stated in the caption.

rules.title: Solid line on the left
rules.when: the line immediately to the left of the lane is solid
rules.action: PASS across that line
rules.statement: WHEN the line immediately to the left of the lane is solid, the DRIVER SHOULD NOT PASS across that line.
rules.note: The handbook describes passing as unsafe here, rather than stating a blanket legal prohibition; the figure includes a solid line on the driver's side of a solid-and-broken pair.

rules.title: Broken line on the left
rules.when: the line immediately to the left of the lane is broken AND the way is clear AND enough broken line remains ahead to complete the PASS safely
rules.action: PASS across that line
rules.statement: WHEN the line immediately to the left of the lane is broken AND the way is clear AND enough broken line remains ahead to complete the PASS safely, the DRIVER MAY PASS across that line.

vague_terms.explanation: no minimum gap or sight distance given

vague_terms.term: enough broken line remains ahead to complete the PASS safely
vague_terms.explanation: no minimum length given

rules.note: The figure includes a broken line on the driver's side of a solid-and-broken pair.

rules.title: Use the right shoulder only for a left-turning vehicle
rules.when: the right shoulder is paved AND the vehicle being overtaken is turning left
rules.action: drive on the right shoulder to PASS that vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN the right shoulder is paved AND the vehicle being overtaken is turning left, the DRIVER MAY ONLY drive on the right shoulder to PASS that vehicle.
rules.note: This rule concerns shoulder use for overtaking.

rules.title: No passing on the left shoulder
rules.when: overtaking another vehicle
rules.action: PASS on the left shoulder, whether paved or unpaved
rules.statement: WHEN overtaking another vehicle, the DRIVER MUST NOT PASS on the left shoulder, whether paved or unpaved.

rules.title: When passing on the right is allowed
rules.when: on a multilane road OR on a one-way road OR overtaking a streetcar OR overtaking a left-turning vehicle
rules.action: PASS on the right
rules.statement: WHEN on a multilane road OR on a one-way road OR overtaking a streetcar OR overtaking a left-turning vehicle, the DRIVER MAY PASS on the right.
rules.note: The separate right-shoulder rule still applies.

rules.title: Wait for slower traffic in the leftmost lane
rules.when: in the leftmost lane behind a slower vehicle
rules.action: wait for the slower vehicle to move right rather than suddenly changing lanes to PASS on the right
rules.statement: WHEN in the leftmost lane behind a slower vehicle, the DRIVER MUST wait for the slower vehicle to move right rather than suddenly changing lanes to PASS on the right.

vague_terms.explanation: no timing or rate of lateral movement specified

rules.title: Do not pass in a two-way left-turn lane
rules.when: a centre lane is designated for two-way left turns
rules.action: use that lane to PASS
rules.statement: WHEN a centre lane is designated for two-way left turns, the DRIVER MUST NOT use that lane to PASS.
rules.note: The regulatory sign reinforces the text by reserving the lane for two-way left turns only.

rules.title: Keep right at passing and climbing lanes
rules.when: on a two-lane section with a signed climbing or passing lane
rules.action: keep to the right-hand lane
rules.statement: WHEN on a two-lane section with a signed climbing or passing lane, the DRIVER MUST keep to the right-hand lane, UNLESS passing another vehicle.
rules.note: The regulatory sign states this more strongly than the roadway description, which explains how the lanes serve slower and faster vehicles.

rules.title: Merge left when a passing or climbing lane ends
rules.when: in the right-hand passing or climbing lane AND a sign warns that the right lane ends
rules.action: merge safely with traffic in the lane to the left
rules.statement: WHEN in the right-hand passing or climbing lane AND a sign warns that the right lane ends, the DRIVER MUST merge safely with traffic in the lane to the left.

vague_terms.explanation: no merge gap or merge point specified

rules.note: The sign caption states the requirement more strongly than the description of the lane-ending warning.

rules.title: Use freeway left lanes for passing
rules.when: driving on a multilane FREEWAY
rules.action: use the left lanes to PASS traffic travelling below the speed limit, avoid remaining in the far left lane after passing, and return to the right-hand lane when possible
rules.statement: WHEN driving on a multilane FREEWAY, the DRIVER MUST use the left lanes to PASS traffic travelling below the speed limit, avoid remaining in the far left lane after passing, and return to the right-hand lane when possible.

vague_terms.explanation: no gap or time to return specified

rules.note: The handbook first gives this as advice, then uses the stronger commands to use the far left lane for passing and not stay there; the separate truck restriction still applies.

rules.title: Use the truck passing lane where the far left lane is restricted
rules.when: passing on a high-speed road with at least three lanes in the direction of travel AND large trucks are prohibited from using the far left lane
rules.action: use the lane immediately to the right of the far left lane for passing
rules.statement: WHEN passing on a high-speed road with at least three lanes in the direction of travel AND large trucks are prohibited from using the far left lane, the DRIVER of a large truck MUST use the lane immediately to the right of the far left lane for passing.

vague_terms.explanation: no size threshold given here
no speed threshold given here

rules.note: The handbook says this restriction applies on many such roads, not on every road with three or more lanes.

rules.title: Obey a slower-traffic-keep-right sign
rules.when: travelling more slowly than other traffic on a multilane road with a slower-traffic-keep-right sign
rules.action: keep to the right-hand lane
rules.statement: WHEN travelling more slowly than other traffic on a multilane road with a slower-traffic-keep-right sign, the DRIVER MUST keep to the right-hand lane.

vague_terms.term: travelling more slowly than other traffic
vague_terms.explanation: no speed difference specified

rules.title: Do not pull around a blockage in an intersection on the road test
rules.actor: DRIVER taking the Level Two road test
rules.when: driving through an intersection AND the lane is blocked by a left-turning vehicle or a vehicle edging in from the right
rules.action: slow down or stop instead of pulling out to go around the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN driving through an intersection AND the lane is blocked by a left-turning vehicle or a vehicle edging in from the right, the DRIVER taking the Level Two road test MUST slow down or stop instead of pulling out to go around the vehicle.
rules.note: The handbook also instructs drivers generally not to change lanes in or near an intersection; the road-test section expressly describes this overtaking situation.

rules.title: Let the overtaking driver pass
rules.when: another driver is about to overtake and PASS the vehicle
rules.action: move to the right and allow the other vehicle to PASS safely
rules.statement: WHEN another driver is about to overtake and PASS the vehicle, the DRIVER MUST move to the right and allow the other vehicle to PASS safely.

vague_terms.explanation: no prescribed lateral movement or gap

rules.note: The sample question uses “must” and its answer key confirms the action; the main text gives the same rule as a command.

rules.title: Do not speed up while being passed
rules.when: another driver is trying to PASS the vehicle
rules.action: speed up
rules.statement: WHEN another driver is trying to PASS the vehicle, the DRIVER MUST NOT speed up.
rules.note: The handbook expressly calls speeding up in this situation unlawful.

rules.title: Help an overtaking driver clear the opposing lane
rules.when: being passed on an undivided road AND the overtaking driver has moved into the opposing lane
rules.action: watch oncoming traffic, move closer to the right side of the lane and be prepared to slow down to help the overtaking driver return sooner to avoid a collision
rules.statement: WHEN being passed on an undivided road AND the overtaking driver has moved into the opposing lane, the DRIVER MUST watch oncoming traffic, move closer to the right side of the lane and be prepared to slow down to help the overtaking driver return sooner to avoid a collision.

vague_terms.term: closer to the right side of the lane
vague_terms.explanation: no lateral clearance specified

rules.title: Clear a truck passing lane
rules.when: in the truck passing lane immediately to the right of a truck-restricted far left lane AND a truck wants to PASS
rules.action: move into the lane to the right as soon as possible
rules.statement: WHEN in the truck passing lane immediately to the right of a truck-restricted far left lane AND a truck wants to PASS, the DRIVER MUST move into the lane to the right as soon as possible.

vague_terms.explanation: depends on an available safe gap

rules.title: Discourage unsafe same-lane passing
rules.when: travelling more slowly than other traffic AND the lane is too narrow to be shared safely
rules.action: use any part of the lane to discourage passing
rules.statement: WHEN travelling more slowly than other traffic AND the lane is too narrow to be shared safely, the CYCLIST or moped rider MAY use any part of the lane to discourage passing.

vague_terms.term: too narrow to be shared safely
vague_terms.explanation: no minimum shared-lane width given

rules.note: This is a stated safety exception to the expected right-side position for slower bicycles and mopeds.

rules.title: Leave at least one metre when passing a cyclist
rules.when: passing a CYCLIST
rules.action: keep at least 1 metre between the vehicle and the CYCLIST, where practical
rules.statement: WHEN passing a CYCLIST, the DRIVER of a motor vehicle MUST keep at least 1 metre between the vehicle and the CYCLIST, where practical.
rules.penalty: Possible fine and two demerit points.

vague_terms.explanation: the handbook does not specify when maintaining one metre is impractical

rules.title: Change lanes to pass a cyclist whenever possible
rules.when: passing a CYCLIST AND changing lanes is possible
rules.action: change lanes to PASS
rules.statement: WHEN passing a CYCLIST AND changing lanes is possible, the DRIVER of a motor vehicle SHOULD change lanes to PASS.

vague_terms.explanation: no available-gap or lane-width criterion given

rules.note: This records the cyclist-specific advice; the later general passing instructions use stronger command wording for overtaking bicycles and other small vehicles.

rules.title: Avoid unnecessary horn use when overtaking a cyclist
rules.when: overtaking a CYCLIST
rules.action: sound the horn unnecessarily
rules.statement: WHEN overtaking a CYCLIST, the DRIVER MUST NOT sound the horn unnecessarily.

vague_terms.explanation: no test for when a warning is needed

rules.title: Give a brief light horn warning from a distance if needed
rules.when: overtaking a CYCLIST AND a horn warning is needed
rules.action: tap the horn quickly and lightly while still some distance away from the CYCLIST
rules.statement: WHEN overtaking a CYCLIST AND a horn warning is needed, the DRIVER MUST tap the horn quickly and lightly while still some distance away from the CYCLIST.

vague_terms.explanation: left to the driver's judgement
no duration or intensity specified
no distance specified

rules.title: Stay behind smaller vehicles during a left turn
rules.when: turning left behind a motorcycle, bicycle, limited-speed motorcycle or moped
rules.action: stay behind rather than pulling alongside to turn, turn when the way is clear, and wait until the smaller vehicle moves right before passing
rules.statement: WHEN turning left behind a motorcycle, bicycle, limited-speed motorcycle or moped, the DRIVER MUST stay behind rather than pulling alongside to turn, turn when the way is clear, and wait until the smaller vehicle moves right before passing.

vague_terms.explanation: no minimum gap specified

rules.note: The instruction to wait for the smaller vehicle to move right does not authorize a same-lane pass.

rules.title: Do not overtake smaller vehicles in the same lane
rules.when: overtaking a motorcycle, bicycle, limited-speed motorcycle or moped
rules.action: change lanes to PASS rather than passing in the same lane
rules.statement: WHEN overtaking a motorcycle, bicycle, limited-speed motorcycle or moped, the DRIVER MUST change lanes to PASS rather than passing in the same lane.
rules.note: This passage gives the stronger lane-change instruction; the cyclist section says to change lanes whenever possible, and the figure shows the driver leaving the lane to pass a cyclist on a lane with a SHARROW.

rules.title: Give large commercial vehicles extra room on return
rules.when: passing a large commercial vehicle
rules.action: allow more room when returning in front of it and do not cut in closely
rules.statement: WHEN passing a large commercial vehicle, the DRIVER MUST allow more room when returning in front of it and do not cut in closely.

vague_terms.explanation: no size threshold given here
no additional return gap specified
no distance defining a close cut-in

rules.note: The diagram illustrates why more room is needed; its example stopping distances are not passing clearances.

rules.title: Stay back from a wide right turn
rules.when: a large vehicle ahead is making a right turn
rules.action: stay well back until it has completely cleared the lane rather than advancing into the space that opens to its right
rules.statement: WHEN a large vehicle ahead is making a right turn, the DRIVER MUST stay well back until it has completely cleared the lane rather than advancing into the space that opens to its right.

vague_terms.explanation: no size threshold given here
no minimum gap specified

rules.title: Stay back from a wide left turn
rules.when: a large vehicle ahead is making a left turn where two left-turn lanes are available
rules.action: stay well back until it has cleared the turn rather than advancing into the lane to its left
rules.statement: WHEN a large vehicle ahead is making a left turn where two left-turn lanes are available, the DRIVER MUST stay well back until it has cleared the turn rather than advancing into the lane to its left.

vague_terms.explanation: no size threshold given here
no minimum gap specified

rules.note: The handbook gives an expressway off-ramp with two left-turn lanes as an example.

rules.title: Let a signalling transit bus pull out
rules.when: approaching in the lane adjacent to a municipal transit bus stopped at a dedicated bus stop AND the bus signals its intent to re-enter that lane
rules.action: yield to the bus and allow it to re-enter traffic
rules.statement: WHEN approaching in the lane adjacent to a municipal transit bus stopped at a dedicated bus stop AND the bus signals its intent to re-enter that lane, the DRIVER MUST yield to the bus and allow it to re-enter traffic.
rules.note: The bus-bay procedure identifies the flashing left-turn signal; the rear sign is a reminder of the duty at a dedicated bus stop.

rules.title: Approach slow-moving farm machinery cautiously
rules.when: approaching farm machinery displaying a SLOW-MOVING VEHICLE SIGN
rules.action: slow down, proceed cautiously, stay well back and wait until it is safe to PASS
rules.statement: WHEN approaching farm machinery displaying a SLOW-MOVING VEHICLE SIGN, the DRIVER MUST slow down, proceed cautiously, stay well back and wait until it is safe to PASS.

vague_terms.explanation: no specific manoeuvre or speed given
no following distance specified
no minimum passing gap or sight distance given

rules.title: Slow and wait before passing a horse-drawn vehicle
rules.when: approaching from behind a horse-drawn vehicle
rules.action: slow down, use extra caution, maintain a safe following distance and wait until it is safe to PASS
rules.statement: WHEN approaching from behind a horse-drawn vehicle, the DRIVER MUST slow down, use extra caution, maintain a safe following distance and wait until it is safe to PASS.

vague_terms.explanation: no specific additional action stated
no horse-specific following gap given
no minimum passing gap or sight distance given

rules.title: Give a horse-drawn vehicle maximum clearance
rules.when: passing a horse-drawn vehicle
rules.action: give as much distance as possible between the vehicles
rules.statement: WHEN passing a horse-drawn vehicle, the DRIVER MUST give as much distance as possible between the vehicles.

vague_terms.explanation: no fixed lateral clearance given

rules.note: A close pass may startle the horse.

rules.title: Watch for doors when passing parked vehicles
rules.when: passing parked vehicles
rules.action: watch for doors that might suddenly open or are open for loading or unloading
rules.statement: WHEN passing parked vehicles, the DRIVER MUST watch for doors that might suddenly open or are open for loading or unloading.

rules.title: Check for passing cyclists before opening a door
rules.when: parked beside the roadway AND about to open a vehicle door
rules.action: look behind and check the mirrors and the relevant BLIND SPOT for passing cyclists, and open the door only if it will not endanger anyone or interfere with traffic
rules.statement: WHEN parked beside the roadway AND about to open a vehicle door, the DRIVER MUST look behind and check the mirrors and the relevant BLIND SPOT for passing cyclists, and open the door only if it will not endanger anyone or interfere with traffic.
rules.penalty: Three demerit points for improper door opening.

vague_terms.term: endanger anyone or interfere with traffic
vague_terms.explanation: no minimum clearance or time gap specified

rules.title: Use the Dutch reach to check for passing traffic
rules.when: opening the driver's door of a parked vehicle beside traffic
rules.action: use the right hand to open the door so that the motion prompts a shoulder check
rules.statement: WHEN opening the driver's door of a parked vehicle beside traffic, the DRIVER SHOULD use the right hand to open the door so that the motion prompts a shoulder check.
rules.note: The handbook describes this as a good practice, not a requirement to use a particular hand.

rules.title: Limit how long a door stays open beside passing traffic
rules.when: a vehicle door must be opened next to traffic
rules.action: keep it open only long enough to load or unload passengers
rules.statement: WHEN a vehicle door must be opened next to traffic, the DRIVER MUST keep it open only long enough to load or unload passengers.

vague_terms.term: only long enough to load or unload passengers
vague_terms.explanation: no fixed time limit given

rules.title: Allow for the length and speed of a double-trailer vehicle
rules.when: preparing to PASS a LONG COMMERCIAL VEHICLE on a highway
rules.action: recognize the rear placard and allow for the vehicle's extended length and limited speed
rules.statement: WHEN preparing to PASS a LONG COMMERCIAL VEHICLE on a highway, the DRIVER SHOULD recognize the rear placard and allow for the vehicle's extended length and limited speed.

vague_terms.term: allow for the vehicle's extended length and limited speed
vague_terms.explanation: no additional passing distance or time specified

rules.title: Prepare to stop for school-bus amber lights
rules.when: approaching a school bus with its overhead amber lights flashing
rules.action: slow down and prepare to stop
rules.unless: approaching the bus from the front on the opposite side of a MEDIAN
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a school bus with its overhead amber lights flashing, the DRIVER MUST slow down and prepare to stop, UNLESS approaching the bus from the front on the opposite side of a MEDIAN.
rules.note: The amber lights warn that the bus is about to stop; they are not the red-light or stop-arm stopping trigger.

rules.title: Stop at least 20 metres behind a school bus with an active stop signal
rules.when: approaching a school bus from behind AND the bus has flashing overhead red lights or an activated stop arm
rules.action: stop at least 20 metres behind the bus
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a school bus from behind AND the bus has flashing overhead red lights or an activated stop arm, the DRIVER MUST stop at least 20 metres behind the bus.
rules.penalty: Heavy fine and six demerit points for a first offence.
rules.note: The handbook states the rule for any road regardless of lane count, speed limit or school hours; the figures show the rear stopping distance on both divided and undivided roads.

rules.title: Stop for a school bus when approaching from the front
rules.when: approaching a school bus from the front AND the bus has flashing overhead red lights or an activated stop arm
rules.action: stop at a safe distance so children can get off the bus and cross in front of the vehicle
rules.unless: a MEDIAN separates the driver's roadway from the bus
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a school bus from the front AND the bus has flashing overhead red lights or an activated stop arm, the DRIVER MUST stop at a safe distance so children can get off the bus and cross in front of the vehicle, UNLESS a MEDIAN separates the driver's roadway from the bus.
rules.penalty: Heavy fine and six demerit points for a first offence.

vague_terms.explanation: no numeric stopping distance given for this approach

rules.note: The 20-metre minimum applies to the rear approach, not the front approach.

rules.title: Remain stopped until the school bus releases traffic
rules.when: stopped as required for a school bus with flashing overhead red lights or an activated stop arm
rules.action: proceed
rules.unless: the bus has moved AND its overhead red lights have stopped flashing AND its stop arm is no longer activated
rules.statement: WHEN stopped as required for a school bus with flashing overhead red lights or an activated stop arm, the DRIVER MUST NOT proceed, UNLESS the bus has moved AND its overhead red lights have stopped flashing AND its stop arm is no longer activated.
rules.note: This uses the stricter combined wording in 6.89; 8.26 says the bus moves or the lights stop flashing, and 8.31 says to remain stopped until the arm folds away and all lights stop flashing.

rules.title: Pass a streetcar on the right
rules.when: passing a streetcar
rules.action: PASS on its right
rules.statement: WHEN passing a streetcar, the DRIVER MUST PASS on its right, UNLESS driving on a one-way road.

rules.title: Stop behind the rear doors of a boarding streetcar
rules.when: approaching a stopped streetcar at a stop where passengers are getting on or off
rules.action: stop and stay at least 2 metres behind the streetcar's rear doors
rules.unless: an area is set aside for streetcar passengers at the stop
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a stopped streetcar at a stop where passengers are getting on or off, the DRIVER MUST stop and stay at least 2 metres behind the streetcar's rear doors, UNLESS an area is set aside for streetcar passengers at the stop.
rules.note: The diagram shows the distance measured from the rear doors rather than from the rear end of the streetcar.

rules.title: Pass streetcar passenger islands cautiously
rules.when: passing a streetcar stop with a passenger safety island or other set-aside passenger area
rules.action: pass at a reasonable speed and be prepared for pedestrians to move suddenly or unexpectedly
rules.statement: WHEN passing a streetcar stop with a passenger safety island or other set-aside passenger area, the DRIVER MUST pass at a reasonable speed and be prepared for pedestrians to move suddenly or unexpectedly.

vague_terms.explanation: no numeric speed given

rules.title: Do not pass a moving snow plow
rules.when: following or approaching from behind a moving snow plow
rules.action: PASS the snow plow
rules.statement: WHEN following or approaching from behind a moving snow plow, the DRIVER MUST NOT PASS the snow plow.
rules.note: The handbook says not to pass a moving snow plow under any conditions; flashing blue lights identify snow-removal vehicles.

rules.title: Do not pass between staggered snow plows
rules.when: snow plows are staggered across the roadway to clear multiple lanes
rules.action: try to PASS between the plows
rules.statement: WHEN snow plows are staggered across the roadway to clear multiple lanes, the DRIVER MUST NOT try to PASS between the plows.
rules.note: The plows can have projecting wings and pass a ridge of snow from one plow to the next.

rules.title: Slow and pass roadside workers or vehicles cautiously
rules.when: passing roadside workers, roadside assistance vehicles or disabled vehicles
rules.action: slow down, pass with caution and move over a lane if safe to do so
rules.statement: WHEN passing roadside workers, roadside assistance vehicles or disabled vehicles, the DRIVER MUST slow down, pass with caution and move over a lane if safe to do so.

vague_terms.explanation: no passing speed or clearance specified
no minimum lane-change gap specified

rules.note: The construction-zone instructions separately say not to change lanes within the work zone; stopped emergency vehicles and tow trucks displaying the specified lights have their own rules.

rules.title: Do not follow closely behind a responding fire vehicle
rules.when: a fire vehicle responding to an alarm has passed and is travelling ahead
rules.action: follow within 150 metres of the fire vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN a fire vehicle responding to an alarm has passed and is travelling ahead, the DRIVER MUST NOT follow within 150 metres of the fire vehicle.
rules.note: The handbook states the minimum following distance generally for any fire vehicle responding to an alarm, in its instructions for resuming travel after being passed by an emergency vehicle.

rules.title: Clear the way for an approaching emergency vehicle
rules.when: an emergency vehicle approaches from any direction with flashing red or red-and-blue lights or a sounding siren or bell
rules.action: stop immediately as near as practical to the right-hand curb or roadway edge, keeping parallel to the roadway and clear of intersections, ramps and the shoulder
rules.unless: on a one-way road or divided highway with more than two traffic lanes, in which case stop at the closest curb or roadway edge OR an enforcement officer is directing the driver where to stop
rules.statement: WHEN an emergency vehicle approaches from any direction with flashing red or red-and-blue lights or a sounding siren or bell, the DRIVER MUST stop immediately as near as practical to the right-hand curb or roadway edge, keeping parallel to the roadway and clear of intersections, ramps and the shoulder, UNLESS on a one-way road or divided highway with more than two traffic lanes, in which case stop at the closest curb or roadway edge OR an enforcement officer is directing the driver where to stop.
rules.penalty: Possible fine and three demerit points for a first failure to stop; higher fines and possible jail for subsequent offences.

vague_terms.explanation: no specified lateral distance

rules.note: The closest-edge exception changes where to stop, not whether to stop; if in a roundabout, the handbook directs the driver to exit before pulling over, and the emergency-vehicle procedure calls for checking traffic, signalling and braking gradually rather than making a sudden manoeuvre.

rules.title: Wait for emergency vehicles to pass before rejoining traffic
rules.when: stopped to let an approaching emergency vehicle pass
rules.action: wait for it to pass, watch for additional responding emergency vehicles, verify that the way is clear and signal before merging back into traffic
rules.statement: WHEN stopped to let an approaching emergency vehicle pass, the DRIVER MUST wait for it to pass, watch for additional responding emergency vehicles, verify that the way is clear and signal before merging back into traffic.

vague_terms.explanation: no merge gap specified

rules.title: Slow down and pass stopped emergency vehicles or tow trucks cautiously
rules.when: approaching on the same side of the road in the direction of travel a stopped emergency vehicle flashing red or red-and-blue lights or a stopped tow truck flashing amber lights
rules.action: assess surrounding traffic speeds and roadway conditions, reduce speed and proceed with caution
rules.statement: WHEN approaching on the same side of the road in the direction of travel a stopped emergency vehicle flashing red or red-and-blue lights or a stopped tow truck flashing amber lights, the DRIVER MUST assess surrounding traffic speeds and roadway conditions, reduce speed and proceed with caution.
rules.penalty: Three demerit points for failing to slow and carefully pass a stopped emergency vehicle.

vague_terms.explanation: no amount of reduction specified
no fixed passing clearance or speed given

rules.note: The handbook also says the law and penalties apply to a tow truck stopped on a highway with intermittent amber flashes.

rules.title: Brake early for a stopped emergency vehicle or tow truck
rules.when: slowing to pass a stopped emergency vehicle flashing red or red-and-blue lights or a stopped tow truck flashing amber lights on the same side of the road in the direction of travel
rules.action: brake early and gradually
rules.statement: WHEN slowing to pass a stopped emergency vehicle flashing red or red-and-blue lights or a stopped tow truck flashing amber lights on the same side of the road in the direction of travel, the DRIVER MUST brake early and gradually.

vague_terms.explanation: no braking start point or deceleration rate given

rules.title: Use the brakes rather than downshifting to signal slowing
rules.when: slowing to pass a stopped emergency vehicle flashing red or red-and-blue lights or a stopped tow truck flashing amber lights on the same side of the road in the direction of travel
rules.action: use the brakes rather than downshifting so the brake lights come on
rules.statement: WHEN slowing to pass a stopped emergency vehicle flashing red or red-and-blue lights or a stopped tow truck flashing amber lights on the same side of the road in the direction of travel, the DRIVER of a manual-transmission vehicle SHOULD use the brakes rather than downshifting so the brake lights come on.

rules.title: Move over for a stopped emergency vehicle or tow truck
rules.when: approaching a stopped emergency vehicle flashing red or red-and-blue lights or a stopped tow truck flashing amber lights in the direction of travel AND there are at least two lanes in that direction
rules.action: move into a lane away from the stopped vehicle in addition to slowing down and proceeding with caution
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a stopped emergency vehicle flashing red or red-and-blue lights or a stopped tow truck flashing amber lights in the direction of travel AND there are at least two lanes in that direction, the DRIVER MUST move into a lane away from the stopped vehicle in addition to slowing down and proceeding with caution, UNLESS moving over is not safe.
rules.penalty: Three demerit points for failing to move over where possible for a stopped emergency vehicle.

vague_terms.explanation: no fixed passing clearance or speed given
no minimum gap or speed differential specified

rules.note: The handbook also says the law and penalties apply to a tow truck stopped on a highway with intermittent amber flashes.

rules.title: Check traffic and move over well in advance
rules.when: moving over to pass a stopped emergency vehicle flashing red or red-and-blue lights or a stopped tow truck flashing amber lights
rules.action: check ahead, to both sides and in the mirrors, slow with surrounding traffic, signal, recheck the mirrors and the BLIND SPOT, and change lanes safely well in advance
rules.statement: WHEN moving over to pass a stopped emergency vehicle flashing red or red-and-blue lights or a stopped tow truck flashing amber lights, the DRIVER MUST check ahead, to both sides and in the mirrors, slow with surrounding traffic, signal, recheck the mirrors and the BLIND SPOT, and change lanes safely well in advance.

vague_terms.explanation: no target speed or deceleration specified
no minimum gap or lead distance specified

rules.note: Check particularly for traffic approaching the target lane too fast or moving into it at the same time, and continue braking gradually after moving over when safe.

rules.title: Do not pass in fog
rules.when: driving in fog
rules.action: PASS another vehicle or speed up to PASS a slower vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN driving in fog, the DRIVER MUST NOT PASS another vehicle or speed up to PASS a slower vehicle.
rules.note: The reminder says not to pass, using stronger language than the earlier advice to avoid passing.

rules.title: Avoid passing in blowing snow or whiteout
rules.when: driving in blowing snow or a whiteout
rules.action: PASS another vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN driving in blowing snow or a whiteout, the DRIVER SHOULD NOT PASS another vehicle.
rules.note: The general advice is to avoid passing; the more specific instruction below prohibits attempting to pass a slow vehicle.

rules.title: Do not attempt to pass a slow vehicle in blowing snow or whiteout
rules.when: driving in blowing snow or a whiteout AND a vehicle ahead is moving slowly
rules.action: attempt to PASS that vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN driving in blowing snow or a whiteout AND a vehicle ahead is moving slowly, the DRIVER MUST NOT attempt to PASS that vehicle.

vague_terms.explanation: no speed threshold specified

rules.note: This is stronger than the general advice to avoid passing in those conditions.

rules.title: Do not pass a pilot or pace vehicle displaying a flashing no-passing sign
rules.when: following a pilot or pace vehicle bearing the no-passing-when-flashing sign AND its warning signal is flashing
rules.action: PASS that vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN following a pilot or pace vehicle bearing the no-passing-when-flashing sign AND its warning signal is flashing, the DRIVER MUST NOT PASS that vehicle.
rules.note: The image supplies the “when flashing” condition; the caption identifies the vehicles covered.

rules.title: Allow more time and space when passing with a trailer
rules.when: preparing to PASS another vehicle
rules.action: make sure there is enough time and room to complete the PASS accounting for the longer combination and reduced acceleration
rules.statement: WHEN preparing to PASS another vehicle, the DRIVER towing a trailer MUST make sure there is enough time and room to complete the PASS accounting for the longer combination and reduced acceleration.

vague_terms.explanation: no extra distance or time specified

rules.title: Leave more room before returning with a trailer
rules.when: returning to the original lane after a PASS
rules.action: allow more room than when passing without a trailer before moving back into the lane
rules.statement: WHEN returning to the original lane after a PASS, the DRIVER towing a trailer MUST allow more room than when passing without a trailer before moving back into the lane.

vague_terms.explanation: no additional return gap specified

rules.note: Returning too soon can cause the trailer to sway.

rules.title: Pull over to let a queue pass when towing
rules.when: holding up a line of traffic
rules.action: signal, pull over and let the other vehicles pass
rules.statement: WHEN holding up a line of traffic, the DRIVER towing a trailer MUST signal, pull over and let the other vehicles pass.

vague_terms.term: holding up a line of traffic
vague_terms.explanation: no minimum queue length or delay specified

rules.title: Steer rather than brake if a passing truck or bus displaces the trailer
rules.when: air turbulence from a passing large truck or bus pushes the trailer sideways
rules.action: carefully steer the vehicle and trailer back into position without braking
rules.statement: WHEN air turbulence from a passing large truck or bus pushes the trailer sideways, the DRIVER towing a trailer MUST carefully steer the vehicle and trailer back into position without braking.

vague_terms.explanation: no size threshold specified
no steering rate or correction magnitude specified

rules.title: Consider a slight speed increase to recover trailer position
rules.when: recovering after air turbulence from a truck or bus that has passed pushes the trailer sideways
rules.action: consider increasing speed slightly to help restore the vehicle and trailer's position
rules.statement: WHEN recovering after air turbulence from a truck or bus that has passed pushes the trailer sideways, the DRIVER towing a trailer SHOULD consider increasing speed slightly to help restore the vehicle and trailer's position.

vague_terms.explanation: no amount of speed increase specified

rules.note: The source says a slight increase may help; this is recovery advice, not permission to speed up while another driver is trying to pass.
